subject: Post-call recap & exec next steps: ZenLytics discovery
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@zenlytics.com>, Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & exec next steps: ZenLytics discovery

Thanks again for the time today, Elena and Tom — really helpful conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps to align on exec priorities and procurement path. Please reply with any corrections.

Summary of pain points we heard:
- Current MLP/embedding pipeline is incurring high inference costs and inconsistent latency across regions; impacts customer-facing search and recommendations.
- On-prem data residency requirements for certain accounts (EU customers) complicate hosting strategy.
- Recent QC/regression with model outputs has increased manual review overhead for your ML ops team.

Business goals you shared:
- Reduce per-query inference cost by ~30% while maintaining current quality metrics.
- Achieve 99.5th-percentile latency targets under 120ms for API path used by the customer UX.
- Hit SOC 2 compliance and support EU data residency within this fiscal year.

Risks and open items we discussed:
- Integration work around your custom tokenization and existing KV cache strategy (engineering effort estimate needed).
- Procurement timeline: you indicated an internal approval window of 6–8 weeks, with Tom as executive sponsor.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive brief (30 min): Marissa + Aditya + Tom + Elena + Lauren — proposed times M/Tu 10:00–11:30 PT next week. Purpose: align on business outcomes, procurement path, and final TCO.
2) Tech kickoff (60 min): Solutions engineer (Lauren) + ZenLytics infra/ML team to scope integration and quantization plan.
3) Share materials: attached redwood-deck-zenlytics.pdf (tailored exec brief) and SOW-template.docx for procurement review.
4) Security/compliance: we will surface SOC 2 evidence and data residency options; please confirm if you need on-prem evaluation or VPC-only.

Can you confirm: (a) Tom as exec sponsor, (b) procurement@zenlytics.com be included on procurement threads, (c) which time window works for the exec brief?

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-deck-zenlytics.pdf; SOW-template.docx

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@zenlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Baxter <tom.baxter@zenlytics.com>, procurement@zenlytics.com
Date: 2026-06-10T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & exec next steps: ZenLytics discovery

Marissa — thanks for the clear summary. This looks right from our side. A few clarifications:

- Confirmed: Tom Baxter (CTO) will be the exec sponsor and will attend the brief if schedule permits.
- Procurement: please loop procurement@zenlytics.com on any SOW/contract threads; our procurement lead is out next week but is back 6/22.
- Data residency: our priority is EU workload support for EU customers; we are open to a VPC deployment initially and may evaluate on-prem later. SOC 2 is a hard requirement.
- Budget: we have a notional allocation but final approval requires a 2-step sign-off (budget + procurement).

Suggested exec brief times: Tue 6/15 10:00 PT or Wed 6/16 10:30 PT. Either works for Tom tentatively.

Appreciate the deck — I will circulate internally. Could you also include a short TCO snippet that shows the cost delta vs our current provider for a 6-month pilot? That will help speed procurement questions.

> Thanks again for the time today, Elena and Tom — really helpful conversation....

Best,
Elena Rodriguez

elena@zenlytics.com

Date: 2026-06-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & exec next steps: ZenLytics discovery

Thanks, Elena — great. Locking in Tue 6/15 10:00 PT for the exec brief (calendar invites sent).

A couple quick follow-ups from our side:
- TCO snippet: attached slide in the deck (page 3) shows modeled delta for a 6-month pilot vs a typical unmanaged endpoint; Aditya will surface more detailed usage assumptions.
- Tech kickoff: Lauren, can you propose 3 slots for next week for the 60-min deep dive so ZenLytics infra can attend?
- SOC 2 / data residency: I’ve attached a short checklist and will request SOC 2 artifacts from our security team; Elena, can you confirm any additional audit constraints beyond SOC 2 and EU residency?

Mutual Action Plan (high-level) — please consider as working: 
- Week 0: Exec brief (align outcomes + procurement path)
- Week 1–2: Tech kickoff + integration scoping (Lauren leads)
- Week 3–6: Pilot deployment + validation (engineering + CS)
- Week 6–8: Procurement & contracting

Aditya & Lauren: I’ll need a short risk notes doc for the exec brief that calls out (1) integration complexity, (2) data residency options & cost delta, and (3) any temporary fallbacks if latency targets aren’t met initially. Can we have that by EOD Monday?

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-06-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Exec brief prep and escalation items (ZenLytics)

Marissa / Lauren — quick internal note ahead of the exec brief tomorrow. Please treat as internal action items; I included as a cc in Marissa's mailbox so it threads.

Escalation / prep items:
- Discount approval: ZenLytics is likely to ask for a pilot discount tied to a 6-month commit. I’ve filed discount-approval-request.pdf (attached) — need approval from Sales Ops (Seth) by EOD Monday if we want to include pricing in the exec brief.
- Integration risk: Lauren, please prepare a 1-page technical runbook (integration steps, estimated FTE-hours, potential blockers for tokenization/kv cache). Bring to the tech kickoff.
- Data residency: Security will need to weigh in on VPC vs on-prem cost/time; I’ll loop in Security after exec brief if Tom confirms EU requirement.

Ask: can we finalize a one-slide risk summary and a single-line pricing proposal (pilot price + escalation to standard rates) for the exec brief? I can take the pricing line once Seth confirms.

Thanks — I’ll join the exec brief with Marissa.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
